Interface VirtualView

All Superinterfaces:
Remote, Serializable, ViewInterface
All Known Implementing Classes:
MockVirtualView, VirtualViewRMI, VirtualViewSocket
public interface VirtualView extends ViewInterface, Serializable
Virtual view interface for handling the communication between the game logic and the view layer over the network. It extends ViewInterface and serializes the data for remote communication.
